Sound effects used in Ordinary Day of a Photographer

All source recordings below are published under CC0 1.0 Universal:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Public preview audio was downloaded from each source page on 2026-10-22.
Edits: trimming, fades, high-pass filtering, loudness normalization and mono encoding.
The fanfare and dinosaur are designed sound effects; the other files are recordings.
Fashion uses the shutter recording; the procession uses the fanfare.
